test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A 725 m long train passes through a 235 m long tunnel in 48 sec. Find the speed of the train.
solution:
**Given:**

Length of the train (Lₜᵣₐᵢₙ) = 725 m

Length of the tunnel (Lₜᵤₙₙₑₗ) = 235 m

Time (t) = 48 sec

**Formula used:**

Speed = dfrac{Distance}{Time}
